description: Corrigo air handling unit controller with the ventilation application 3.6: settings, actual values, run mode, inputs and outputs, alarm points and statuses, timers and holidays, setpoints and alarm limits
source: Regin, Corrigo ventilation: list of network variables for EXOline, Modbus and BACnet communication, revision 20 (July 2016), software 3.6

sources.title: Corrigo ventilation, list of network variables for EXOline, Modbus and BACnet communication
sources.note: chapters 3-6, coil status, input status, input and holding registers

notes: Modbus RTU (or Modbus TCP on controllers with an Ethernet port), slave address 1 by default; at most 47 registers per read.
Addresses are the manual's Modicon numbers without the leading digit (input register 30054 is input register 54), counted from 1 (address_base 1).

Real values are sent multiplied by 10, time settings by 100 and air flows by 1 (manual, 'Scale factor Modbus'). This map applies 100 to the timer and holiday signals, 1 to signals whose description is an air flow and 10 to the other real signals.
Index values with different numbering for BACnet are listed with their Modbus values. To override an output, set it to manual and write its ..._ManSet register.
Written from the manufacturer's manual; not tested on a device.
